description: hexe's single LTX 2.3 video workflow (updated Nov 17: core LoRA loaders and core Load Audio, no VHS/rgthree). First frame, or first + last frame (ns_toggle_use_LF), generated sound or the song as audio in (ns_toggle_use_audio_in), vocals isolated for lip-sync (ns_toggle_isolate_vocals). 3 stages, the INT8 ConvRot model. Inputs found by their ns_ titles. Nightshift resolves the switches before queueing, so unused loaders drop out (no dummy last frame or audio file needed). Load Audio has no start time: pass a clip already cut to the shot. Same image as first and last frame = a locked-off camera.
